🔻 Armed Forces commanders warn of decisive response to any aggression

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Senior commanders of Iran’s Armed Forces have emphasized that the country’s security is a red line, noting that any aggressor would face a forceful, decisive, and appropriate response.

In a message issued on Tuesday on the occasion of Sacred Defense Week, the commander of the Iranian Army’s Air Defense Force, Brigadier General Alireza Elhami, emphasized that the Sacred Defense serves as an important lesson for successive generations in protecting the country’s independence, dignity, and territorial integrity, highlighting the crucial role of air defense personnel and martyrs in safeguarding Iran’s airspace.
​
Referring to the legacy of air defense martyrs, Brigadier General Elhami said that the experience of the Sacred Defense serves as a foundation for the current generation of the force, which, relying on indigenous knowledge, experience, and capabilities, continues its mission of protecting the country’s airspace and territorial integrity alongside other armed forces.
​
In another message, Air Force commander Brigadier General Bahman Behmard described the memory of the martyrs of the Sacred Defense and the defenders of the shrine as a legacy of faith, sacrifice, and selflessness, emphasizing their role in preserving Iran’s dignity and independence.
​
He added that the spirit of sacrifice and resistance embodied by the martyrs was also carried on by Iranian forces during the recently imposed war by the US and Israeli regimes, as they stood against threats and made sacrifices to defend the country’s sovereignty and independence.
​
In a separate message, Navy commander Rear Admiral Shahram Irani stressed the continuation of the culture of sacrifice and resistance in the face of aggression and threats, saying that the Iranian people and Armed Forces stood against the recent US-Israeli aggressions and defended the country’s security and independence.
​
Emphasizing the Armed Forces’ readiness to defend the country’s borders, Rear Admiral Irani said that the Navy, relying on faith, expertise, and combat readiness, remains prepared to comprehensively defend Iran’s national interests and dignity at any time.
​
In another message, the head of Iran’s Civil Defense Organization, Brigadier General Gholamreza Jalali, said in a message marking Sacred Defense Week that the 12-day war and the Ramadan war demonstrated the continued relevance of the lessons of the Sacred Defense, stressing the need for constant preparedness, reliance on domestic capabilities, and national unity in the face of military, economic, cultural, and media threats.
​
He described passive defense as responsible for reducing the vulnerability of critical infrastructure, ensuring the continuity of public services, and enhancing national resilience. Jalali said the experience of the 12-day war highlighted the need for a modern approach based on continuity of operations, recoverability, and risk management.

🎙 Leader: Students have historic mission to advance Islamic Iran

📌 New York, IRNA — Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, issued a message at the beginning of the new academic year on Tuesday, saying the students and scholars have a historic mission to elevate Islamic Iran by acquiring knowledge, piety, hope, ethics, wisdom and capability while overcoming the boundaries of knowledge and advancing scientific progress.

The following is the full text of his message:
​
In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful
​
"Allah will raise in rank those of you who have faith and those who have been given knowledge" (Quran 58:11).
​
The start of the new academic year and the reopening of the houses of knowledge and letters in schools and universities, heralds vitality, hope, and the nation's swift movement toward a bright and glorious future. This is a future whose realization rests in the capable hands of the dear children of Iran and those educated by the school of Islam and the Islamic Revolution. This is the same generation in which the Great Khomeini and the magnanimous Martyr Khamenei, may God elevate their noble stations, repeatedly expressed their hope.
​
Now that the gates of a new academic year are opening before a vast multitude of students, scholars, and wayfarers in pursuit of knowledge and wisdom and they begin a new chapter of learning and insight with hope in divine success, it’s fitting that we once again honor the memory of the students martyred in the recent Imposed War in sympathy with the grieving mothers and fathers. This year, the memorable days marking the start of the academic year renew the grief of separation from our departed children for us. In schools and universities, the absence of some students, professors, and teachers will be felt. And this sorrow will guide our minds toward the true nature of the conflict between good and evil, and the war between Truth and Falsehood.
​
It’s the responsibility of today's students and scholars to strive to equip themselves with knowledge and piety, hope and ethics, and wisdom and capability. They must also remove the veils of ignorance and darkness so that by breaking the boundaries of knowledge and conquering the progress-building summits, they may fulfill their historic mission to elevate Islamic Iran. This task is carried out in a place that is their second home. Therefore, I say to these dear people that it’s necessary for you to always safeguard its sanctities in the best possible manner. And by continually raising your level of awareness and insight, and by improving your conduct and character, make this the focal point of your homeland's progress. Take full advantage of the few years you spend in this sanctuary of knowledge, letters, and vitality, and hope for your own self-improvement. This self-improvement includes self-improvement in the most important element of human life, which is connection with the Creator, the Exalted; self-improvement in your relations with your fellow human beings, your compatriots, and your family; and self-improvement in acquiring knowledge and attaining every kind of skill.
​
During this time, practice thinking correctly, taking action with initiative, and always be the guardians of the roots of your national identity, your cultural honor and independence, your mother tongue, the sacred flag of the Islamic system, and its other symbols. Soon the time will come when you will find your proper role in society. In fulfilling that role in the best possible manner, you will bring honor to yourselves and to your country.
​
In an age when the savagery of the system of domination — particularly the criminal US government and the illegitimate Zionist regime — is rampant . . .
